_comment: Settings for scripts/finetune_eicu.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored; any other unknown key is an error. CLI flags override this file.
_agents: The T22 flagship: ALL-8 minus cadence (eICU has no order-entry table).
_split: hospital = test hospitals never seen in fine-tuning (comparable to T22). patient = within-hospital, easier.
_train_patients: 0 = all eICU train patients; set e.g. 500/2000/10000 for a learning curve.
_seed: The MIMIC source stack and the eICU split are fitted once at seed; each of seeds re-rolls everything trained on eICU (agent fine-tunes, continued boosting and its folds, both heads).
_source: MIMIC source fit, same as score_eicu.py.
_finetune: Warm-started from MIMIC weights at 10x lower LR. Early stopping on eICU val, seeded with the pretrained score.
_gbm_device: cpu is deterministic; cuda is faster but not bit-reproducible.
_freeze_agents: ecg_meas sees no ECGs on eICU, so there is nothing to adapt.
